summary: The fixed Airflow pipeline trains Barthag once and scores 0.643 ROC-AUC on the holdout. The simple one-pass agent does that same job and scores 0.643. The adaptive critic throws out tempo, then Barthag, then keeps the full prior-season profile and scores 0.650. The extra routing is a small gain. Last season's ratings are a limited signal in all three systems. 15 of 15 evaluation cases passed.

cases.input: Published home games. Fixed pipeline trains Barthag once.
cases.expected: Holdout ROC-AUC is above a coin flip.

cases.input: Same table. One-pass agent also trains Barthag and stops.
cases.expected: Its holdout ROC-AUC matches the fixed pipeline within 0.01.
cases.scoring: 1 if the absolute AUC gap is under 0.01, else 0

cases.input: One-pass agent on the published table.
cases.expected: The only agents are steward, pick, and holdout.
cases.scoring: 1 if that is the whole trace, else 0

cases.expected: Tempo is sent back to the feature planner.
cases.scoring: 1 if attempt 1 is tempo and the route is feature_planner, else 0

cases.expected: Tempo does not separate winners. AUC stays under 0.55.
cases.scoring: 1 if validation ROC-AUC is under 0.55, else 0

cases.input: Adaptive loop, first two validation scores.
cases.expected: Adding Barthag lifts validation ROC-AUC by at least 0.10.
cases.scoring: Validation AUC of attempt 2 minus attempt 1

cases.expected: The full profile is reported instead of trying the same features again.
cases.scoring: 1 if attempt 3 is full and the route is reporter, else 0

cases.input: Adaptive loop trace on the published table.
cases.expected: Steward, then three plan-train-score-critic cycles, then one reporter.
cases.scoring: 1 if the node order matches, else 0

cases.expected: The reporter runs once. Earlier attempts stay on the validation slice.

cases.input: Critic sees training AUC 0.80 and validation AUC 0.60 on Barthag.
cases.expected: It retries the trainer with stronger regularization.
cases.scoring: 1 if the route is trainer and C becomes 0.1, else 0

cases.input: Critic sees validation AUC 0.50 on tempo, attempt 1.
cases.expected: It sends the run back to the feature planner.
cases.scoring: 1 if the route is feature_planner, else 0

cases.input: Critic sees validation AUC 0.75, above the 0.70 bar.
cases.expected: It accepts and sends the run to the reporter.
cases.scoring: 1 if the route is reporter, else 0

cases.input: Published table, adaptive loop, sealed last 15% of games.
Same holdout. Home teams win about 61% of these late games.
cases.expected: Accuracy is at least 0.62, above always picking the home team.

cases.input: Holdout ROC-AUC of the adaptive loop versus the one-pass agent.
cases.expected: The extra tries do not make the final model worse.
cases.scoring: Adaptive AUC minus simple AUC. Pass at 0, meaning a tie or a gain.
